spans.notes: OLD_DESIGN: the earlier Pudgy look throughout: bright yellow beaks and feet (~RGB 240,208,64), paler rose and periwinkle bodies, a glossy shaded sky-coloured sofa. One take: it opens close on the rose penguin sulking under a blanket on the sofa and pulls back f0-~24; the blue penguin walks in from the right with a plate of sushi, sits at the other end and eats while the rose one glares, and later the rose one shifts and leans toward him. A pinned wall poster with a heart and a printed message (in-world text) hangs above the sofa throughout. One reason for the whole run, so one span
